rules.name: RustybouncerScrapeDown
rules.query: up{job="rustybouncer"} == 0

annotations.summary: Metrics scrape unavailable; SQL health is unknown

rules.name: RustybouncerTargetsMissing
rules.query: absent(up{job="rustybouncer"})

annotations.summary: No rustybouncer scrape targets; check discovery and configuration

rules.name: RustybouncerMetricContractMissing
rules.query: (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1) unless on (job, instance) rustybouncer_routing_enabled

annotations.summary: Scrape succeeded but routing contract gauge is missing

rules.name: RustybouncerNoPrimary
rules.query: (rustybouncer_topology_nodes{role="primary"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_topology_discovery_completed == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: No eligible unambiguous primary after discovery

rules.name: RustybouncerAmbiguousPrimary
rules.query: (rustybouncer_topology_ambiguous == 1) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_topology_discovery_completed == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Multiple writable nodes persist; investigate fencing

rules.name: RustybouncerDiscoveryNotStarted
rules.query: (rustybouncer_topology_discovery_completed == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

rules.name: RustybouncerDiscoveryStale
rules.query: (rustybouncer:discovery_age_seconds{discovery_profile="interval500ms_timeout1000ms"} > 15) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Discovery completion is stale for the configured probe profile

rules.name: RustybouncerDiscoveryProfileMissing
rules.query: ((up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1) unless on (job, instance) rustybouncer_routing_enabled{discovery_profile="interval500ms_timeout1000ms"}) and on (job, instance) rustybouncer_routing_enabled

annotations.summary: No matching discovery freshness budget; configure a reviewed profile
No matching discovery freshness budget; configure a reviewed profile

rules.name: RustybouncerCapacityPressure
rules.query: (rustybouncer:client_utilization:ratio > 0.9) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Admitted clients exceed 90 percent of configured capacity

rules.name: RustybouncerRouterFailures
rules.query: (rustybouncer:router_delivery_error_ratio:rate5m > 0.05) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 1) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Router or delivery errors exceed 5 percent with traffic

rules.name: RustybouncerReadRetryAmplification
rules.query: (rustybouncer:read_retry_amplification:rate5m > 0.2) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 1) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="rustybouncer"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Additional read selections exceed 20 percent of read messages

rules.name: rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m
rules.query: sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total[5m]))

rules.name: rustybouncer:router_delivery_error_ratio:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total{outcome=~"router_error|delivery_error"}[5m])) / rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:sql_error_ratio:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total{outcome=~"sql_error"}[5m])) / rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:aborted_ratio:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total{outcome=~"aborted"}[5m])) / rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:q_duration_p50_seconds:rate5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(rustybouncer_query_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:q_duration_p95_seconds:rate5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(rustybouncer_query_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:q_duration_p99_seconds:rate5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(rustybouncer_query_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:client_utilization:ratio
rules.query: (rustybouncer_clients_active / rustybouncer_client_capacity) and (rustybouncer_client_capacity > 0)

rules.name: rustybouncer:backend_connections:sum
rules.query: sum by (job, instance) (rustybouncer_backend_connections_active)

rules.name: rustybouncer:attempts_per_q_message:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_query_attempts_total[5m])) / rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer:q_messages_per_second:rate5m > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:read_retry_amplification:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_read_retries_total[5m])) / sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total{kind="read"}[5m]))) and on (job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_queries_total{kind="read"}[5m])) > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:attempt_failure_ratio:rate5m
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_query_attempts_total{outcome=~"error|aborted"}[5m])) / sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_query_attempts_total[5m]))) and on (job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (rate(rustybouncer_query_attempts_total[5m])) > 0) and on (job, instance) (rustybouncer_routing_enabled == 1)

rules.name: rustybouncer:discovery_age_seconds
rules.query: clamp_min(time() - rustybouncer_topology_last_completed_timestamp_seconds, 0) and (rustybouncer_topology_discovery_completed == 1)
